text.title: 桌上的两张说明卡
text.situation:
学习工作坊里，林和玛雅把两张说明卡放在计时器旁。一张显示穿过社区中心的路线，另一张用文字说明同一条路线。她们的任务是提出比较两种说明的方法。招募志愿者之前，导师请她们先检查措辞，解释活动步骤。报告草稿称志愿者为experimental subjects，邀请函则用participants。每个人参加前都需要理解活动并表示同意。玛雅删去了承诺地图一定更好的句子，因为这正是她们想调查的问题。林增加了提问的位置，并说明会记录哪些信息。导师又递给她们两张标着“示范数据”的散点图，让她们练习描述关系，而不假装拟议研究已经产生了结果。

工作坊示范
图A把练习时间与完成题数配对，示范正相关。图B把练习时间与完成所需时间配对，示范负相关：一个变量较高时，另一个往往较低。这里的inverse指负向关联，没有确定严格的反比例公式。构造的示例用来练习描述，不是拟议比较得出的结果。要询问说明形式是否造成差异，小组必须设计合适的比较，并考虑其他影响。

玛雅：练习时间与完成题数相关，就能说多练习造成了这个差异吗？
导师：图显示的是关联。解释原因，需要更多依据。
林：那邀请函应该说明活动并征求同意，不应该承诺一定进步。
导师：对。核对完措辞后，把两张卡再带回来。报告与邀请函面向不同读者，但应该说明同一个步骤。

paragraphs.en: In the learning workshop, Lin and Maya put two instruction cards beside a timer. One showed a route through the centre; the other gave the same route in words. Their assignment was to propose a way of comparing the cards. Before recruiting anyone, the tutor asked them to inspect the wording and explain the procedure. The draft report called the volunteers experimental subjects, while the invitation used participants. Each person would need to understand the activity and give consent before taking part. Maya removed a sentence that promised the map would be better: that was the question they wanted to investigate. Lin added a place for questions and a clear account of what would be recorded. The tutor then handed them two scatter plots labelled demonstration data. They could practise describing relationships without pretending that their own proposed study had already produced results.

paragraphs.en:
Workshop demonstration
Plot A pairs practice time with completed items and illustrates a positive correlation. Plot B pairs practice time with completion time and illustrates an inverse correlation: higher values of one variable tend to accompany lower values of the other. Here, inverse means a negative association; it does not establish an exact reciprocal formula. These constructed examples teach description, not results from the proposed comparison. To ask whether the instruction format causes a difference, the group must design a suitable comparison and consider other influences.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: If practice time correlates with the number of completed items, can we say the extra practice caused the difference?
Tutor: The plot shows an association. You need more than that to explain the cause.
Lin: Then our invitation should describe the activity and ask for consent, rather than promise an improvement.
Tutor: Yes. Bring both cards back after you have checked their wording. The report and the invitation have different audiences, but they should describe the same procedure.

S04.V10.P01.cue: 为两种说明卡写一条邀请，说明志愿者身份、活动步骤与征求同意，不承诺结果。
acceptableAnswers: 我们邀请参与者比较两张说明卡。报告会将其称为实验对象。活动开始前会解释步骤，并征求同意。

S04.V10.P02.cue: 向同伴描述两张示范散点图的方向，不用它们证明原因。
acceptableAnswers: 图A示范正相关。图B示范负相关，这里的inverse指负向关联。两张图都没有确定关系的原因。

S04.V10.P03.cue: 修改一段把相关写成因果的草稿，并说明下一步要核对什么。
acceptableAnswers: 练习时间可能与分数相关，但单凭图不能确定原因。提出更强结论前，应该检查说明，并设计合适的比较。

S04.V10.T01.cue: 一份校园问卷发现自报阅读时间与分数相关。给老师提出一句准确的结果描述和一个后续问题。
acceptableAnswers: 这些回答中，自报阅读时间与分数相关，呈现正相关；但这没有显示分数差异单由阅读时间造成。比较还应该考虑哪些其他影响？
